title: HlithRunArtifact
description: The JSON that `hlith run --artifact-out` writes (hlith.cli.build_artifact). Every object is closed. cli-2: from the current schema effect.deltas, effect.delta_set_sha256 and top-level deltas are always written, so they are required; artifacts written before that merge lack them and are cli-1. top-level graph is always written since the current schema.

delta_set_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical delta set (sorted by id, JSON sort_keys, separators (',',':'), ensure_ascii); null when no deltas.

deltas.description: null when the effect carries no delta claims; otherwise the claim report (always with a confirmation object).

graph.description: null without --layer1; the Layer 1 report with it. Always written since the current schema .

delta_rel.description: delta_rel: REQUIRED, may be []. Non-gating evidence; never read by decide().

target_python.description: Informational, optional, never read by the gate: the interpreter the confined differential worker REPORTED ABOUT ITSELF (sys.executable / sys.version_info / sys.implementation.name seen inside the confinement). Absent when no evaluator started (never inferred from the requested python).

allOf.description: no deltas <=> null sha <=> null report
a Layer 1 payload/observed mismatch is an incident: refused, exit 4

provenance.description: How the check ran, recorded by the supervisor (hlith.types.CheckProvenance). Never set by the proposer.

evidence.description: Bounded evidence for a verdict: what was explored and, explicitly, what was not. Never universal correctness.

account_id.description: obligation.account_id: the effect account this obligation was derived from

covered_by_delta.description: Post-gate probe divergences NOT pinned because a confirmed, landed intended delta covers them (never dropped silently).

unpinned_witnesses.description: Refuting calls from the differential that Layer 5 did not pin verbatim (fault injection or size-capped): unresolved and owned.

recurrent_in_callee_cone.description: A construct that stopped an earlier refused run, now reached only through the callee cone. Non-blocking and visible.

superseded_by_delta.description: Loaded pins NOT applied in this run because the confirmed (human-approved) delta set covers their pinned input; the record is kept and the supersession appended beside it, never deleted.

recurrent_constructs.description: Constructs of this run that already stopped earlier refused runs (Layer 5 not_derived_construct records, matched on file + node digest, changed side). Information, NOT an obligation: the gate blocks through the run's own unresolved-* obligations. One entry per construct.

feedback_effect.description: per-run counterfactual: what decide() would give over the same derived obligations without the feedback-origin obligations; informational, never the verdict; exact=false (without=null, no flip claimed) when feedback seeded a remaining check's domain

feedback_report.description: Layer 5 for this run: records loaded before derive, records written after the gate by the supervisor.

kind.description: claim-violation: the stage did something outside the claim (account kind or manifest): REFUTED, labelled. not-modelled: only files the effect account has no record of : NOT_DERIVED, nothing compared. unreconciled-missing-declaration: a required declaration source is missing. undeclared-effect: legacy (before the split), still valid for older artifacts; new emitters use the two specific kinds .

intended_delta.description: Proposer CLAIM of an intended behaviour change (runtime.validate_delta). Never evidence by itself: it needs independent confirmation (recorded approval of delta_set_sha256). predicate+expected (both or neither) make it machine-checkable; without them it is advisory and can never cover a divergence. Receiver/argument state after the call is NOT part of expected in V1: a delta whose post state also differs still refutes. id uniqueness per set is enforced by the runtime.

oneOf.description: Boolean expression over the declared param. Shape and length only here; the grammar (closed AST whitelist, depth/node caps) is owned by differential, which rejects a bad expression fail-closed (UNVERIFIED).

expr.description: COMPUTED post value over the callable's bound parameters, in the closed grammar of hlith.expected_expr (validated there; never eval'd). The approval hash covers this text.

env.description: environment variables set for the call; null unsets

args_after.description: repr of (args, kwargs) after the call, present only when the call mutated them

probe.description: extended post-landing probe replay data: family, derandomised seed, the input's origin (a seeded family or a repository call site) and the probe's total wall budget in seconds

tests.description: repository tests referencing the symbol that a held verdict relied on and that missed the divergence

node_sha256.description: sha256 of the construct's source node (effect account provenance); the record applies only while the same node is present

v0_design.description: Retained v0 artifact shape for reference. NOT written by cli.build_artifact and not referenced. It validates nothing.

delta_set_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical delta set: sorted by id, JSON sort_keys, separators (',',':'), ensure_ascii.

provenance.description: How the check ran, recorded by the supervisor (hlith.types.CheckProvenance). Never set by the proposer.

evidence.description: Bounded evidence (hlith.types.BoundedEvidence). held never means universal correctness.

delta_report.description: Proposer delta claims for this run. claim_only: never proof. advisory_ids: deltas without predicate+expected.

oneOf.description: CheckProvenance-shaped record of a human approval: not a confined process, so it can never back a held obligation; it only unblocks.

graph_report.description: Layer 1 (optional LangGraph orchestration, --layer1): interrupt before the gate, checkpointed state, resume. A payload/observed mismatch is an incident (exit 4). A delivered artifact always has payload_matches_observed=true: a mismatch exits 4 with no artifact; the false case stays valid here (refused, exit 4) only for mutation tests.

claimed_digest.description: sha256 of the sorted path -> mode + content-digest claim the graph measured (not a patch hash).

feedback_executions.description: times the feedback node ran (proves exactly once)

socket_events.description: audit-hook log of socket events in the confined graph process

socket_events_scope.description: Which process the socket_events audit covers (the confined graph driver; the worker child is not audited; kernel denial is the control).

proposer.description: Layer 1 agent run: who wrote the change (supervisor-side proposer; credentials never enter the worker). plumbing_only true = a scripted mock proves the loop and the confinement, NOT agent behaviour.

command_argv_sha256.description: hash of the exact local CommandProposer argv array; raw argv is not disclosed

redo_inflight.description: true only when the operator explicitly requested repeating a proposer call whose completion was indeterminate

thread_store.description: directory of the durable LangGraph thread store the paused thread was persisted to (hlith resume THREAD_ID reads it)

local_binding_provenance.description: Optional (add-only, 2026-11-19): complete-local-binding evidence for a return shape resolved through local assignments (assignment scan flags, scope, assignment list). Consumed read-only by the return-shape adapter; absent means 'not proven'.

alias_targets.description: Optional pre/post resolved targets of a changed type alias.

forwarded_keyword_mapping.description: Optional signature-derived mapping for forwarded keyword arguments.

acct_provenance.description: Effect-account claim provenance : which pass made the claim, from which source node.

literal.description: Python source of an int (any operator) or str (== / != only); bool excluded

acct_entry_guard.description: Modelled entry guard: discriminated on raises_when; every variant carries the raised exception, condition source + sha256, site, node and provenance. No legacy plain form; an unresolved exception stays an unsupported_entry_guard construct.

side.description: tree the site was resolved on: impacted_call_sites = pre, post_call_sites and nested added/deleted sites = post
base side, changed side or both

kind.description: e.g. dynamic_getattr, unsupported_entry_guard, syntax_parser_disagreement (tree-sitter vs LibCST)

provenance.description: acct_guard_provenance (with the required assumptions) when kind is unsupported_entry_guard, else acct_provenance; selected in allOf

side.description: base side, changed side or both

raised_exception.description: exception a guard raises (module-qualified when resolved), else null

condition_source.description: source text of the guard condition, else null

node_id.description: syntax node id of the construct

record_node_id.description: module_level_change only: node_id of the modified_module_level row this blocker stands for (omitted otherwise)

target_arg_flow.description: _target_arg_flow: target param -> caller param | receiver field | unresolved expression

oneOf.description: emits {} when the caller or receiver class is not indexed

opaque_caller_guards.description: Opaque caller guards, always emitted ([] when none). Required in the current schema.

modified_module_level.description: , always emitted ([] when none). Required in the current schema.

effect_account_dict.description: EffectAccount.to_dict() with names (side_effect_primitive_delta is emitted as side_effect_primitives_delta). Every record is closed: a new or renamed field fails validation.

account_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical account JSON (sort_keys, separators (',',':'), ensure_ascii)

sidecar.description: set when the canonical account JSON exceeds 4 MiB; then account is null

base_tree_sha256.description: key name; the value is the git tree id of the target HEAD (40 hex for SHA-1 repositories, 64 for SHA-256), equal to target.base_tree

run_report.description: run identity. Duplicates feedback/graph/target values by design; the validation test checks they agree.

conditional.description: def sits under a conditional (if/try/...): present on single-def nodes, absent on group nodes

acct_syntax_node.description: Single def: node_id,node_type,node_sha256,start_line,end_line,conditional. Nested defs and conditional duplicate defs are GROUP nodes: nested/nested_nodes (+qualified_name, enclosing_qualified_name) or conditional_duplicate/conditional_nodes, each member a node of this same shape. Fields added by later engine versions are optional in older artifacts; see the schema.

acct_syntax_identity.description: : tree-sitter cross-tree node identity for a callable (pre/post nodes; null when absent on that side). Optional nested_* / conditional_* fields appear only for nested defs and conditional duplicate defs.

acct_callable_provenance.description: Callable claim provenance: acct_provenance plus the required tree-sitter syntax_node_identity .

acct_deleted_callable.description: : a callable the change deletes, with the post-tree call sites that still reference it. An empty post_call_sites list does not establish safety (unexplored_scope says why).

binding_provenance.description: Optional provenance for the unique import binding of a constant reader.

acct_constant_reader.description: A reader of a modified constant. Direct path = [reader, constant]; transitive = caller -> ... -> reader -> constant.

acct_modified_constant.description: : a module-level constant whose value changed, its readers and provenance. Side absence is the only reason a side's line/source/hash is null; an annotation-only binding has an empty source + sha256(''), resolved false, literal null.

acct_callee_edge.description: : an edge from a modified callable into its callee cone.

kind.description: e.g. dynamic_getattr, unsupported_entry_guard, syntax_parser_disagreement (tree-sitter vs LibCST)

provenance.description: acct_guard_provenance for unsupported_entry_guard, else acct_provenance; selected by kind below.

raised_exception.description: exception a guard raises (module-qualified when resolved), else null

condition_source.description: source text of the guard condition, else null

node_id.description: syntax node id of the construct

record_node_id.description: Optional node id of the modified module-level record represented by this callee-cone blocker.

acct_callee_unresolved_construct.description: : an unresolved construct inside the callee cone of a modified callable. Evidence in unexplored_scope; it does not create a gate obligation.

acct_effect_flag.description: : an effect observed in a caller/constructor context (e.g. kind 'resource') with its site and source

acct_return_shape.description: : one statically observed return shape. bare return / fallthrough: kind none, source ''; explicit return None: source 'None'.

delta_rel_item.description: delta_rel: non-gating Z3 delta-relational evidence for one modified callable. decide() never reads it; PROVED does not replace the repository test slice. Only COUNTEREXAMPLE also seeds run_differential.

symbol.description: qualified name of the modified callable

z3.description: z3.get_version_string() of the hard z3 dependency

pre_sha256.description: sha256 of the utf-8 source segment of this callable on the base side (whole file text only if it cannot be located)

oneOf.description: derive-level failure of the delta_rel generator (exception before the check ran); verdict is then UNMODELED

items.description: param -> value_repr (JSON-safe whatever the model's integers)

fragment_notes.description: one line: what the grammar covers / why UNMODELED

proof_tier.description: : unconditional = numeric-fragment Z3 proof over the whole annotated domain, no unverified premise about other code; conditional = UF mode, valid only under `assumptions`, must never be admitted alone; none = COUNTEREXAMPLE/UNMODELED (nothing proved). PROVED <=> unconditional|conditional. Non-gating: decide() never reads it. Optional until every emitter pass carries it , then required.

assumptions.description: : premises a PROVED stands on, in emitter order (UF: the callee premise first). conditional: at least one; none: empty; unconditional: empty unless declared deltas are taken as given. Present only with proof_tier.

z3.description: z3.get_version_string() of the hard z3 dependency

pre_sha256.description: sha256 of the utf-8 source segment of this callable on the base side (whole file text only if it cannot be located)

acct_value_site.description: _method_parameter_value_sites: the call-site expression whose class was resolved, and how

acct_class_candidate.description: _caller_parameter_facts class candidate; value_site only when basis came from a call-site value

receiver_class_qualname.description: runtime class whose MRO resolves self/cls/super().ATTR to the changed attribute; null for explicit Class.ATTR reads

acct_class_attr_reader.description: class-attribute reader (same shape as constant readers plus receiver_class_qualname); path runs reader -> ... -> Class.ATTR

pre_value_sha256.description: sha256(pre_value_source); null when the pre side is absent

pre_literal_value.description: JSON literal value when resolved, else null

acct_modified_class_attribute.description: changed class-attribute binding (separate from module-level modified_constants)

assumptions.description: environment assumptions the claim depends on, sorted and unique, e.g. 'assumes target python 3.14' when a builtin alias was selected by a sys.version_info branch; [] when none

acct_guard_provenance.description: Entry-guard claim provenance: acct_provenance plus the required assumptions list .

timings_report.description: Wall-clock seconds per pipeline phase . Informational only: never read by decide(); OPTIONAL top-level key (artifacts without it stay valid).

acct_index_cache_provenance.description: Per-build indexed-file totals of effect index cache. Python side: EffectAccount.index_cache_stats, a separate attribute excluded from EffectAccount.to_dict(); the CLI writes it here as the artifact key effect_account.index_cache_provenance. Lives on the report wrapper, OUTSIDE the account dict, so account_id and account_sha256 do not change between cold and warm runs. REQUIRED on every report; {0,0} when no indexing ran (failed/no-change).

side.description: the guard is unchanged: present on both sides

raised_exception.description: exception a guard raises (module-qualified when resolved), else null

condition_source.description: the guard's condition expression text (same as source)

node_id.description: syntax node id of the construct

callsite_coverage.description: every syntactic call site under the guard is checked irrespective of the guard's truth, so the guard does not block

acct_opaque_caller_guard.description: : an UNCHANGED unsupported entry guard dominating an impacted caller's call sites. Recorded, not a blocker: all call sites below it are checked under both polarities. node_id unique and disjoint from unresolved_constructs (consistency).

kind.description: closed: a new kind is a schema change

source.description: textsafe.clean(original statement text), capped at 4000 chars (newlines escaped: one line)

source_sha256.description: sha256 of the ORIGINAL, uncleaned, uncapped source

acct_module_level_record.description: : one AST-different module-level change (one row per imported name; a replaced statement = pre+post rows sharing pair_id). Each post row and each unpaired pre row is linked by exactly one unresolved_constructs[kind=module_level_change].record_node_id (consistency).
